description: Land Title Settlement Department - Haragama, Kandy Four Gravets D/S Division, Kandy District  - Cad. Map No. 320289  and other declarations
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, owners, extent, and encumbrances) in various locations. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
